_why: ADR 0026's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
This is Jeske's 'fantasy numbers' warning made executable -- she wrote
that pH, temperature, cofactors and buffers play a huge role and that
simply mixing values ends up calculating with fantasy numbers. Coherence
is the check that says so when a model's parameters came from
It is also the highest-risk table in the debt list: one of its eight
mutations was originally NOT CAUGHT, and it was the first of the six
'checks that cannot fail' this project has found.
The runner is vitest rather than jest -- a deliberate second use of the
harness's runner detection, since a COUNT_PATTERNS entry that never
matches would make every verdict INDETERMINATE and look like a spec
problem rather than a harness one.
test: cd Science-Agent-Pipeline/artifacts/api-server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/assayCoherence.test.ts src/__tests__/coherenceEndToEnd.test.ts

mutations._claimed: 0 failed originally. A defaulted parameter also has no assay conditions and was dropped by the next check anyway, so the end-to-end test that claimed to cover this filter passed for an unrelated reason.
mutations._note: The first of the six checks-that-cannot-fail. Tested at its own level against the state the resolver does not yet produce and the next feature might.

mutations.description: `unassessable` becomes a pass when fewer than two parameters report conditions
mutations._note: The inversion the reason text argues against in prose: a gap in the sources is NOT a finding that the model is sound.

_a_narrow_test_command_produces_a_false_: The first version of this file ran only assayCoherence.test.ts and
reported K1 NOT CAUGHT. That was the SET FILE being wrong, not the ADR:
the test that closes K1 lives in coherenceEndToEnd.test.ts, which ADR
0026 names in the same sentence as the other file.
Worth keeping because it is the failure mode a set file has that a
hand-run mutation does not. Running a narrower suite than the record
claims produces a confident NOT CAUGHT that looks like a real gap, and
it would have been recorded as one. The rule: a set's `test` command
must cover every suite the ADR cites, not the one that seems relevant.
